description: Article confirms Dembé protests but gives no participant count or attendance characterization; 50-person threshold unresolved.
required_followup: Seek another contemporaneous report with a count; do not infer attendance from affected households.

description: One broad search call was run in French, English and Arabic. Returned evidence is concentrated in N’Djaména; regional labor, student, transport and land-related actions may be missed.
required_followup: Reviewer may search local outlets and union/community sources for Abéché, Moundou, Sarh, Bol and other provinces.

description: A search result reports a nationwide ban on an MPA march but provides no planned date or evidence of actual action.
required_followup: Seek post-notice reporting only if available; do not infer an event from a prohibition notice.

description: Health-school graduates reportedly held a press conference across several cities on 30 August, but the search snippet gives no headcount and does not establish a mass public protest.
required_followup: No protest candidate is coded absent evidence of public action and simultaneous attendance.

description: A targeted search divided into 1–15 and 16–31 August returned mostly out-of-window or unrelated material and repeated known notices; it did not verify another in-window mass action or resolution of the Dembé protest.
required_followup: Coverage remains incomplete; do not treat absence in this noisy result set as evidence that no other actions occurred.

description: Targeted local-radio and civil-rights searches repeated the Tchadinfos Dembé report but returned no independent radio/rights-group corroboration or additional attendance estimate.
required_followup: Threshold and local-source corroboration remain unresolved; this result set is not exhaustive.
